entries.title: How do I document a visit using voice?
entries.summary: Go to Visit Scribe, click 'Start Recording', speak your observations, then stop. AI automatically transcribes and generates a Medicare-compliant note.

entries.title: Why should I always select a patient in Smart Notes?
entries.summary: Selecting a patient allows AI to personalize documentation using their specific diagnoses, medications, and history. The more visits you document for a patient, the better AI recommendations become.

entries.title: How does AI enhance my clinical notes?
entries.summary: AI expands your observations into skilled nursing language, adds medical necessity justification, includes homebound documentation, and ensures Medicare compliance - all while preserving your clinical intent.

entries.title: What if AI generates incorrect information?
entries.summary: Always review AI-generated content. You can edit directly, regenerate with different parameters, or add your own text. AI learns from your corrections over time.

entries.title: How do I send a fax from my phone?
entries.summary: Use the Camera tab in Send Fax. Capture photos of your documents, add recipient number, and send. AI generates a professional cover page automatically.

entries.title: Can I create custom documentation templates?
entries.summary: Yes! Use Clinical Library to create quick phrases that expand into full documentation. Support both generic and patient-specific templates with variables.

entries.title: Are AI OASIS and PDGM suggestions available?
entries.summary: No. Automated OASIS response guidance, PDGM reimbursement optimization, and M-item financial-impact recommendations are paused pending verified CMS clinical content, tenant-scoped authorization, and required human review. Use the official clinician OASIS workflow and CMS-approved grouper.

entries.title: What happens to flagged compliance issues?
entries.summary: Flagged notes appear in the Compliance Dashboard. Review them, use AI suggestions to fix issues, and re-save. System tracks improvements over time.

entries.title: How do I use a quick phrase while writing a note?
entries.summary: Type “/” in the observations box to open the Quick Phrases picker, type a saved “.shortcut” code, or tap the Quick Phrase button. Phrases bound to a specific patient only appear while charting that patient, and inserted text still goes through compliance review before you save.

entries.title: Why is Save blocked by a facility documentation requirement?
entries.summary: Your administrator defined a critical documentation rule that applies to this patient (for example, an SpO₂ reading for a patient on oxygen). Add the missing detail — the checklist clears automatically — or check the acknowledgment box to save without it. Acknowledged overrides are recorded.

entries.title: When is my timesheet due, and when is payday?
entries.summary: Pay periods are biweekly (Sunday through Saturday). Timesheets are due before noon on the Monday after the period ends, and payday is normally the Friday after the period ends — moved to Thursday when that Friday is a bank holiday, and occasionally adjusted for a specific period when payroll confirms it. The timesheet form shows the authoritative due date and payday for the period you pick.

entries.title: What is the AI-content responsibility agreement I accepted at sign-in?
entries.summary: A one-time acknowledgment (re-shown only if the wording changes) that AI-generated content may contain errors and that you are responsible for reviewing and approving anything you submit. Your acceptance is recorded with your name, the date, and the agreement version.
